blocks.text: Data backup means making a copy of important data to protect it from loss or damage, for example by a virus or a hardware failure. A backup lets data be restored easily; recovery is the process of getting the data back. Every user should back up data regularly.

blocks.caption: Types of data backup
rows: All the changes since the last full backup

blocks.text: Backups can be stored on hard drives or in cloud storage.

items: Backup files are used to restore lost data.
Recovery software helps get deleted files back.
System restore can recover system data.
Professionals can recover data from damaged devices.
